title: Company context
body:
xFPL is a live Fantasy Premier League decision-support web app at xfpl.co.uk. A manager pastes their FPL team ID (no account, no password) and gets, for the gameweek ahead: a projected score for every player in their squad, a captain pick, suggested transfers, a multi-week transfer plan, chip timing and rival analysis - each with a one-line reason built from the figures that produced it. Nothing in the product is written by a language model.

OWNERS: Steven (owner, final authority) and his partner. Both must approve: any spending, production deployments, major product changes, prediction-methodology changes, and anything that could affect existing users. Approval of one change is never approval of the next.

STAGE: early. The product works; the business barely exists. Season 2026/27 in progress. Revenue: none. Cost: GBP 0/month, entirely free tiers. Users: UNKNOWN - nothing measures them.

OBJECTIVES, in Steven's priority order: (1) improve quality and accuracy, (2) create genuinely valuable user experience, (3) build sustainable traffic, (4) avoid unnecessary expenditure, (5) use AI efficiently, (6) strong foundations before scaling.

ESTABLISHED FACTS (audit, 3 Sep 2026):
- CI green on main; 178 backend tests pass. Live API serving from Postgres, not stale.
- GW3 projection frozen 2026-09-03T19:10:40Z, 626 players, tied to commit a96ee3d. First genuine pre-commitment; GW1 and GW2 were reconstructions.
- 2025/26 backtest, 31,117 predictions: Pearson 0.572, Spearman 0.704, MAE 0.931 - computed over ALL players including those who never played.
- Live 2026/27, over players who APPEARED only: GW1 rank correlation 0.20, GW2 0.318.
- Those two figures are NOT comparable and the flattering one is quoted in the README. Open credibility problem.
- Improvement over a last-five-matches baseline: Zeros -19.8%, Blanks -23.6%, Tickers -19.7%, HAULERS -0.5%. Rivals OpenFPL -8.4% and FPL Review -7.9%. Haulers decide gameweeks; this is the central weakness.
- Top predicted decile hauls 30.9% vs a 7.9% base rate and holds 39% of all hauls, but haulers average 7.8 actual against 2.96 predicted. Ranking good, magnitude compressed.
- Season replay: 145 points across GW1-2 vs a field total of 131 - rank 2,561,918 of 10,366,167. No chips played, so a floor.
- robots.txt and sitemap.xml both 404. One title and one description across every page. No OpenGraph tags. NO ANALYTICS OF ANY KIND - not one page view has ever been recorded.
- 21 blog posts exist, hand-authored. A Discord is linked from every post; size UNKNOWN.
- No user accounts; team ID lives in localStorage. No email, no notifications - nothing brings a manager back.
- /squad gates a fourth tracked rival behind "Premium lifts the cap". There is no Premium and nothing to buy.
- recommendation_score is shown to users to three decimals and has never been backtested.
- README describes four modules that no longer exist and says the app has no dark mode; it is dark by default.

DEPLOYMENT: frontend on VERCEL (confirmed 3 Sep from live headers - server: Vercel, x-vercel-id iad1, Next.js). Backend on Render free tier; the keep-alive uses ~730 of 750 monthly free instance-hours, so there is no headroom. Postgres on Neon free tier. All scheduling on GitHub Actions.

THE CALENDAR, which drives sequencing: GW3 deadline 4 Sep, GW4 12 Sep, GW5 18 Sep, then a THREE-WEEK INTERNATIONAL BREAK with no football until GW6 on 10 Oct.

THE STANDING 30-DAY PLAN (CEO, awaiting approval): days 1-4 fix the accuracy-figure inconsistency, remove the Premium gate, drop the unbacktested score, correct the README. Days 4-14 SEO foundation and analytics, live before 18 Sep. Then observe through the break. Read the data at GW6 and decide again. The CPO dissented - traffic without a return mechanism leaks, and the break maximises it - recorded with a reopening trigger.

STILL UNKNOWN, and never to be guessed: current traffic; whether any measurement property exists; Discord size; whether anyone but Steven has used the app; the monthly spend ceiling; whether email capture is acceptable; whether monetisation is a goal this season; Steven's weekly time budget.
